title: Beads / Queues & backlog
description: Bead counts by state, what each command would pick up, and how long beads wait. Queue tiles are per database and are never summed across databases. The --include-focus-required mode of /unblock-human-beads offers the unblock-human queue plus the unblock-human-focus queue.

panels.title: Data age (worst db)
panels.description: How long ago the database with the oldest successful main collection was last collected. Green below 4 minutes, yellow from 4 minutes, red from 10 minutes. A database whose collection is failing drops its series, so every total on this dashboard excludes a stale database: check this tile first.

panels.title: Not closed
panels.description: Beads that are not closed, across the selected databases. This is every bead in exactly one of the states shown beside it. Gates, ephemeral wisps and templates are outside bd's default list view and so outside this count.

panels.title: In progress (claimed)
panels.description: Beads whose stored status is in_progress or hooked: someone has claimed them.

panels.title: Ready to work
panels.description: Beads that bd ready returns: open, unblocked and not snoozed.

panels.title: Blocked (on a bead or gate)
panels.description: Beads with an unresolved blocker, a dependency on another bead or a gate, or with the stored status blocked.

panels.title: Deferred (snoozed)
panels.description: Beads with the stored status deferred, or whose defer-until time is still in the future.

panels.title: Not ready, other reason
panels.description: Not-closed beads that are not claimed, deferred, blocked or ready. This is the sum of two states: merge-request beads (and molecules), which bd ready never returns, and every other bead (pinned, custom statuses, children held back by a parent). The By db table below splits the two.

panels.title: What the commands would pick up
/drain-beads would claim
panels.description: How many beads each database offers to /drain-beads right now. Queue drain-claim: bd ready --exclude-label human,human-focus-required,refactor-campaign --exclude-type epic. Per database, never summed across databases.

panels.title: /drain-beads finishes at 0
panels.description: How many beads keep /drain-beads running before it stops. Queue drain-termination: bd ready --exclude-label human,human-focus-required,refactor-campaign. It includes epics, which /drain-beads never claims. Per database, never summed across databases.

panels.title: Epics stalling /drain-beads
panels.description: Per database: the termination queue minus the claim queue, shown only while the claim queue is empty. A positive value means /drain-beads cannot finish because only epics remain: close finished epics or decompose them. Orange from 1.

targets.expr: sum by (db) (beads_queue_candidates{db=~"$db",queue="drain-termination"}) - on(db) sum by (db) (beads_queue_candidates{db=~"$db",queue="drain-claim"}) and on(db) (sum by (db) (beads_queue_candidates{db=~"$db",queue="drain-claim"}) == 0)

panels.title: /unblock-human-beads
panels.description: How many beads wait for a person and are offered to /unblock-human-beads by default. Queue unblock-human: bd ready --label human --exclude-label refactor-campaign,human-focus-required --exclude-type handoff. Per database, never summed across databases.

panels.title: /unblock-human-beads --focus-required-only
panels.description: How many beads need the operator's own attention. Queue unblock-human-focus: bd ready --label human-focus-required --exclude-label refactor-campaign --exclude-type handoff. The --include-focus-required mode offers unblock-human plus this queue. Per database, never summed across databases.

panels.title: Queue candidates over time
panels.description: How many beads each queue offered, per database, over time. The --include-focus-required mode of /unblock-human-beads offers unblock-human plus unblock-human-focus.

panels.title: Oldest candidate per queue
panels.description: Age of the oldest bead each queue currently offers, per database. A queue with no candidates has no bar.

panels.title: By db
panels.description: One row per database. Data age is the age of the last successful main collection. The state columns add up to Not closed; Merge-request holds merge-request beads and molecules, which bd ready never returns. The last four columns are what each command's queue offers.

panels.title: Not closed by state
panels.description: Not-closed beads by state over time, stacked: the stack height is the not-closed total.

panels.title: Created vs closed, last 24 h
panels.description: Beads created and beads closed in the 24 hours before each point, summed over the selected databases. Each point is a rolling 24-hour count, not a per-interval delta. It is refreshed by the slower throughput pass.

panels.title: Oldest bead per state
panels.description: Age of the oldest not-closed bead in each state (for in progress, the age since it was claimed). In progress turns yellow after 1 day and red after 3 days; a state with no beads has no bar.

panels.title: Not closed by type
panels.description: Not-closed beads by issue type, summed over the selected databases.

panels.title: Not closed by priority
panels.description: Not-closed beads by priority, P0 (most urgent) to P4, summed over the selected databases.

panels.title: Workflow labels
panels.description: Not-closed beads carrying each workflow label, summed over the selected databases. A bead can carry several labels, so these do not add up to a total.

panels.title: Top 20 labels
panels.description: The 20 most common labels among not-closed beads, summed over the selected databases. Labels overlap, so the bars do not add up to a total. The remainder bucket __other__ is left out here and shown in the all-labels table.

panels.title: All labels
panels.description: Every label that has its own series, with its not-closed bead count, summed over the selected databases. __other__ counts beads carrying any label outside the exporter's label cap, once per bead. Labels overlap, so the counts do not add up to a total.

panels.title: Dashboard states and the bd status behind them
panels.description: Each dashboard state with its bead count and the status bd stores for it. Stored open = Ready + Blocked + Merge-request + Other + open beads snoozed under Deferred (gates are outside the not-closed view and so outside both columns).

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (state) (beads_issues{db=~"$db"}), "stored", "in_progress, or hooked", "state", "in_progress"), "stored", "deferred, or open and snoozed", "state", "deferred"), "stored", "open, or blocked", "state", "blocked"), "stored", "open", "state", "ready"), "stored", "open", "state", "tracking"), "stored", "open, or pinned or a custom status", "state", "other")

panels.title: Stored status counts
panels.description: Beads by the status bd stores, summed over the selected databases. Closed comes from bd's status count, which includes closed gates, so it is not comparable with the not-closed columns. Stored open = Ready + Blocked + Merge-request + Other + open beads snoozed under Deferred (gates are outside the not-closed view and so outside both columns).

panels.title: How the two views relate
panels.description: Explains how the dashboard states relate to the statuses bd stores.

options.content: Stored open = Ready + Blocked + Merge-request + Other + open beads snoozed under Deferred (gates are outside the not-closed view and so outside both columns).

panels.title: Collection succeeded, per db
panels.description: 1 when the last main collection of the database succeeded, 0 when it failed.

panels.title: Last success, per db and pass
panels.description: Age of the last successful run of each collection pass, per database. A pass that keeps failing keeps ageing.

panels.title: Errors by pass and reason
panels.description: Collection failures per pass and closed reason, as the increase over the interval. stale_issues_jsonl means a stale issues.jsonl file blocks that database; the alert text says how to clear it.

panels.title: Collection duration
panels.description: Wall-clock duration of the last run of each collection pass, per database.

panels.title: Server health
panels.description: Link to the dashboard for the bead database server itself.

options.content: If a database fails to collect, check the server too: [beads-dolt-server / Metrics](/d/dolt-metrics).
